messages:
mia.docs: Heads-up — opened a small PR that reconciles the Optimize Toolkit snippet inventory + ownership. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821

tara.eng: thanks! what's the scope? just samples or also migration guide?

mia.docs: mostly samples + a short migration checklist. Also fixes two broken doc links in optimize/batching.md and optimize/quant-profiles.md

omar.opt: can you paste the broken link lines? I can patch if needed.

mia.docs: sure -> ```- [quant profiles](../optimize/quant-profiles.md) // should be ../optimize/quantization-profiles.md``` and ```- batching examples: /docs/optkit/batching.md -> /docs/optimize/batching-examples.md```

sophia.pm: we need to ensure SDK snippets still match SDK v1.7.0. pinging jen.qa to sanity check.

jen.qa: I can smoke test the snippets tomorrow AM. prefer a tiny matrix: sync/async, streaming, kv-prefetch.

tara.eng: Omar, any runtime param name changes that affect samples? e.g., `max_tokens_per_batch` -> ?

omar.opt: Not yet. There is a new `microbatch_window_ms` in dedicated config. Samples don't use it, but migration notes should mention it.

mia.docs: plan: 1) merge PR with inventory + link fixes; 2) bump snippets to v1.7.0 where needed; 3) add migration note for microbatch_window_ms + quant profile mapping table.

ci-bot: CI check started for PR #4821 — docs linting + linkcheck.

jen.qa: quick ask: could we add a tiny snippet showing prefix-KV prefetch config? lots of asks.

mia.docs: added minimal snippet in branch at docs/optimize/examples/kv-prefetch.md:
```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 50
  key_ttl: 30000
```

omar.opt: Suggest note: "start with 50ms then tune based on load". I'll add a review comment.

tara.eng: also include a perf note: batching helps throughput but watch tail latency for short-lived requests.

sophia.pm: for the migration guide pls include: update quant profile names, run eval suite, smoke test SDK snippets, update quickstart links.

mia.docs: done — added checklist and emphasized required evals. also converted code fences to use language hints.

jen.qa: CI failed on one snippet: sample_go_streaming.md had `StreamClient` import path wrong.

mia.docs: fixed and pushed. CI re-run.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #4821.

omar.opt: ownership suggestion: optkit-samples@redwood -> examples; docs-team -> wording + migration checklist. tagging in PR description?

mia.docs: tagged owners in PR: @optkit-samples @docs.

sophia.pm: timeline: aim to ship before EOW. blockers?

tara.eng: infra ok. QA expects ~8h for smoke.

jen.qa: I'll prioritize tomorrow AM.

mia.docs: thanks. after merge I'll open a follow-up to track embedding-snippet parity across langs.

tara.eng: small nit — can we consolidate three near-duplicate snippets into one example with toggles? less maintenance.

omar.opt: ++ agree. created tracking ticket OPT-4123 and linked it in the PR.

mia.docs: OPT-4123 created and linked.

jen.qa: LGTM after CI + smoke. @mia.docs please merge after QA signoff.

mia.docs: will merge after QA. Thanks everyone :slightly_smiling_face:
